chunks: 多言多误，多误则羞耻心减，羞耻心减则敬畏心减，敬畏心减则心死，心死则入火狱。
ai.seo_question: what is the spiritual consequence of excessive speech in shia teachings?
ai.summary: attributed to imam ali in nahj al-balagha, this concise chain (silsila) illustrates the metaphysical consequences of unguarded speech, a theme central to shia ethical theology (akhlaq). it emphasizes that verbal excess erodes hayā' (modesty) and wara' (piety), leading to the 'death' of the heart's spiritual perception, a concept deeply explored by scholars like ibn abi al-hadid in his commentary.
